story.vex: Fix your servers all you like. See if command even has a place to sit. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED before it started: the crew keeps operating, systems and people both, regardless of what breaks. Astro: "Systems back is DR. Crew still running is BCP. We need both."

ORDERS FROM ASTRO
=================
Read drill-activities.txt: four activities from the hull-breach drill. Classify each as dr-scope or bcp-scope.

1. type drill-activities.txt
2. classify <activity> dr-scope | bcp-scope
files.C:\\Citadel\\drill-activities.txt:
HULL BREACH DRILL — ACTIVITIES
----------------------------------
activity-1   relocating command to the auxiliary hall while the main hall is repaired
activity-2   restoring a corrupted database backup after an unrelated storage failure
activity-3   assigning a backup officer to speak with allied fleets since the usual liaison is unreachable
activity-4   reinstalling the relay console's software after a crash

steps.title: Volt's Drill: read the activities
steps.body: Volt: "Read all four before sorting any." `type drill-activities.txt`.

steps.title: Sort DR from BCP
steps.body: Volt: "Restoring a system is DR. Keeping the crew and command running, regardless of systems, is BCP." Classify all four activities.
